supra-physiological doses of B6. Disorders of the synthesis and recycling of PLP may also respond dramatically to treatment
with pyridoxine or pyridoxal phosphate.
Deﬁciency of PLP because of insufﬁcient B6 in the diet is rare probably because, at least after infancy, the gut ﬂora can synthesize
signiﬁcant amounts of B6. PLP deﬁciency can, however, occur if we ingest something that binds PLP e.g., large amounts of Gingko
nuts or hydralazine.
